description_zh: 只读探索：快速定位文件、符号与调用关系，返回简洁证据地图。
description_en: Fast read-only explorer for locating files, symbols, and call paths in a codebase.
when_to_use: Use for read-only codebase mapping: locate files/symbols/call paths and return an evidence map. Prefer over dumping many greps into the main context. Always pass thoroughness: quick | medium | very thorough (default medium). Do not use for editing.
